head: 1217ea397766828ecc6aa9afcc3941fff9b85249
title: Transaction validation lets a negative amount through when precision is also negative

bugs.note: Neither amount nor precision is checked for sign at the API boundary, and the deep check only looks at the product. amount -25 with precision -100 gives a positive precise_amount, so the transfer applies while the stored amount says -25, and reports or filters that read amount see the opposite direction.
